probe: H-probe version label (HOSTING section 7.2; ACCESS H-probe): bin/codex --version only
probe_directory: <probe> = a new empty mktemp -d directory outside the repository and outside every account home, holding empty codex-home/, home/, tmp/ and cwd/

command.environment_policy: Explicit four-variable environment; nothing inherited. No credential variable, no CODEX_MANAGED_PACKAGE_ROOT or CODEX_MANAGED_BY_NPM, no npm wrapper. Never ~/.codex. No sign-in, no network use requested.
command.launcher: Python subprocess.run with env= set to exactly the four variables above (the host refused a shell command that sets HOME); timeout 60 s

parsed.syntax: codex-cli <major.minor.patch> with optional final LF (S1 model rule)

side_effects.note: This is the documented S-F-17 write into the home the probe runs against; the three names are symbolic links to <root>/bin/codex. home/, tmp/ and cwd/ stayed empty. The measured tree was unchanged (re-inventory byte-identical).

limits: Paths are redacted to placeholders; the scratch location is machine-local.
This is the label component only. It is not an App launch, a handshake, an App-produced observed-verification.s1 record or runtime verification of an installed bundle.
